title: Vinh in a day
summary: The square, the citadel gate, the Xô viết museum, Núi Quyết, Chợ Vinh, and the sand at Cửa Lò. The beach distances stay 16 km, 17 km, 18 km, and about 20 km.

stops.name: Ho Chi Minh Square
stops.note: Start at the statue and the open square.

stops.name: Vinh Citadel
stops.note: The gate and the yard sit nearly 2 km from the square.

stops.name: Nghe Tinh Soviet Museum
stops.note: See the 1930–1931 rooms in the citadel yard.

approach.note: The rooms are in the citadel yard.

stops.name: Quyet Mountain
stops.note: Climb to the temple, then the view.

stops.name: Vinh Market
stops.note: Use the morning hall at Chợ Vinh for a foam coffee.

stops.name: Cua Lo beach
stops.note: Swim and walk the sand at Cửa Lò.

approach.note: Take Bến Thủy–Trường Thi–Cửa Hội–Cửa Lò or Bến Thủy–Quang Trung–Quán Bánh–Cửa Lò, while the Núi Cấm road is about 30 minutes by car for the 18 km figure.
